recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless Security WG later wants a different verification scenario or additional narrative beyond the approved example.
issue_request: FHIR-55796 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 Security WG change request asking for a Verify Provenance example, following the Remove/Delete example, because a verification-only Provenance can otherwise be unclear about Provenance.target matching Provenance.entity.what.
initial_application: Commit 1b721a8ea9cdce4b9a14ebfb5e8c0f21e68099c8 added the original Provenance verify example in PR HL7/fhir#4066. Later same-PR commit ca28eb99e94284bd0f890882396c0aa9f372ba16 renamed it to source/provenance/provenance-example-verify.xml, changed the id to example-verify, and added the Provenance/example-verify entry to source/provenance/list-Provenance-examples.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists provenance=Provenance, so the example and examples List are in build scope. Security WG minutes for 2026-03-30 corroborate the block-vote resolution for FHIR-55796 and record the remaining block motion passing 7-0-0. FHIR-56165 is an adjacent patient-merge Provenance example from the same PR and already has its own reconciliation audit; it provides scenario context but does not supersede this verify-example request. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The published audit commit records that the current source already has a Provenance example with activity code verify and matching target/entity.what references, and that the example is exposed through the Provenance examples List.

related_jiras.note: A later same-PR Provenance commit renamed and wired the verify example into the Provenance examples List while preserving the verify activity content.
The adjacent patient-merge Provenance example provides scenario context and already has its own AutoFHIR audit commit, but it does not supersede FHIR-55796.
